statements.text: AI could be amazing in calculating and getting things going together faster, but it can also do a lot of misinformation, a lot of harm.
statements.context: Congresswoman Betty McCollum questions a witness during a House Appropriations subcommittee hearing on the Department of the Interior, Environment, and Related Agencies budget for fiscal year 2025.

statements.text: On Thursday, it was great to join Dr. Kimberly Sablon at the U of M along with several Minnesota innovators to discuss the future of AI, autonomy, and our nation’s biggest national security challenges. https://t.co/0g2aFxxMgq

Trump's AI and crypto czar, David Sacks, has illegally overstayed in his temporary job. I'm joining my Democratic colleagues to get answers from the White House as to when he'll be leaving as required by law.
https://t.co/gUWUBvCYNT

The use of Anthropic's artificial intelligence technology by the Department of Defense deserves tough scrutiny from Congress. We must understand exactly how DoD intends to use this technology and should hold hearings on the use of artificial intelligence in the military. Congress must ensure that the private data of Americans is protected and that our citizens are free from warrantless government surveillance. https://t.co/LqIMz7EsVK

Artificial intelligence is an incredibly powerful tool that is reshaping our economy and transforming our society, yet has the potential to cause great harm to our institutions and our communities if ungoverned. Congress has a duty to pass safeguards that ensure this technology works for the American people, not against them. That begins with holding A.I. companies accountable for the risks that their products pose to humanity.

I’m cosponsoring the Reverse Big Ugly Tax Breaks for Data Centers Act, which would repeal massive tax breaks for big tech that were passed by Republicans’ Big Beautiful Bill so that more taxpayer dollars and incentives are not going to big tech companies with no strings attached. I also plan to support The Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act when it is introduced in the House to address the existential threat to humanity poised by super-intelligent AI agents who could conduct unauthorized attacks or subvert commands.

AI CEOs are pleading for Congress to urgently regulate AI. House Republicans? They're too busy campaigning. We cannot allow AI to become autonomous and we need to pause advanced AI development until we can establish strong federal regulations.
 https://t.co/S9cUUT44HB

President Trump and Republicans are failing to hold AI companies accountable for the risks posed by their products. Congress must pass common sense guardrails to protect the health and safety of the public, ensuring that AI doesn’t harm our communities or institutions. https://t.co/HJW2Rwhtso

I’m committed to ensuring data centers can’t be constructed at the expense of our environment, our health, or our utility bills. I’m co-sponsoring the Reverse Big Ugly Tax Breaks for Data Centers Act (H.R. 10448), which would repeal the massive tax breaks for data centers that were included in Republicans’ Big Ugly Bill. I just voted to pass the Ratepayer Protection Act (H.R. 9340) to help prevent data centers from passing the cost of their increased energy consumption on to local communities.
